walkthroughs.body_html:
Empathy: 'I feel your pain.' You share the feeling.

Sympathy: 'I'm sorry you're hurting.' You care, from outside.

Both matter — empathy usually feels closer.

Cognitive empathy — understanding why they feel that way.

Affective empathy — actually feeling it too.

A great friend has both.

Empathy is a skill you build:

  • Active listening — no phone, eye contact.
  • Perspective taking — 'how would I feel?'
  • Read fiction.
  • Spend time with people unlike you.

The world needs more of it. 🌍
